business_rules: Entries created by an automated process cannot be edited by non-administrative users.
Dropdown values are populated using code searches with the user session.
validations: Date inputs are validated for correct formatting.
Dropdown selections are checked against their respective indices for employment status logic.
If session indices are null, they are reset.
conditions: Screen is editable only if created by user or user is a system administrator.
Employment status dropdown determines the dependent dropdown visibility.
system_behavior: JavaScript setup is used for handling dropdown changes in asynchronous postbacks.
Grid buttons visibility is governed by user's administrative privileges.
exceptions: Null session indices are handled by resetting them.
Redirects occur post successful data operations.
